news.title: Tamil Nadu Cabinet Expansion by CM Vijay
news.text: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay expanded his cabinet by inducting 23 new ministers, including Congress representatives. The move strengthens the alliance government and marks a major political development in the state.

news.title: Three-Language Policy Sparks Debate in Tamil Nadu
news.text: The new CBSE circular mandating a three-language policy for Class IX students has triggered strong reactions across Tamil Nadu. Political leaders and educators expressed concerns over language imposition and implementation challenges.

news.title: Chennai Heatwave Intensifies
news.text: Tamil Nadu continues to experience severe summer conditions, with Chennai temperatures touching 42°C. Health officials have advised people to stay hydrated and avoid unnecessary daytime travel.

news.title: Quad Foreign Ministers Meeting in Delhi
news.text: India will host the Quad Foreign Ministers’ meeting in New Delhi on May 26, bringing together leaders from India, the US, Japan, and Australia to discuss Indo-Pacific cooperation and security.

news.title: Monsoon Expected to Reach Kerala Soon
news.text: The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) announced that the southwest monsoon is likely to reach Kerala around May 26, bringing relief from intense summer temperatures across many states.

news.title: India’s IPO Market Faces Slowdown
news.text: India’s IPO market has slowed due to global volatility and cautious investor sentiment. Major companies including Jio Platforms and PhonePe have reportedly postponed public listing plans.

news.title: Global Oil Market Nearing ‘Red Zone’
news.text: The International Energy Agency warned that global oil markets could enter a “red zone” due to Middle East tensions and disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns about fuel prices worldwide.

news.title: AI Safety Report 2026 Released
news.text: An international AI Safety Report backed by global experts and organizations highlighted the growing importance of AI governance, ethical development, and safety regulations for future AI systems..

news.title: Cricket Set for Grand Return at LA 2028 Olympics
news.text: ricket is officially making its return to the Olympic Games at Los Angeles 2028 after more than a century. The sport’s inclusion is expected to significantly boost global viewership, especially from cricket-loving nations like India. Preparations for dedicated cricket venues and qualification pathways are already underway, creating excitement among fans worldwide.

didYouKnow.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.5 Enterprise
didYouKnow.content: OpenAI introduced GPT-5.5 Enterprise with enhanced reasoning, multimodal capabilities, and enterprise-grade security features for large organizations.

didYouKnow.title: Google unveils Gemini Ultra Expansion
didYouKnow.content: Google announced major upgrades to its Gemini AI ecosystem, including deeper Android integration, AI-powered search enhancements, and new developer tools.

didYouKnow.title: Meta accelerates AI wearable devices
didYouKnow.content: Meta revealed new AI-powered smart glasses and wearable assistant features aimed at integrating real-time AI interactions into daily life.

didYouKnow.title: Microsoft expands Copilot AI across Windows
didYouKnow.content: Microsoft expanded Copilot AI integration across Windows and Office products, enabling advanced automation, productivity assistance, and enterprise AI workflows.

didYouKnow.title: Global AI regulation discussions intensify
didYouKnow.content: The U.S., EU, China, and other global leaders continued discussions on international AI governance, focusing on safety, transparency, and responsible AI deployment.
